user.description: Database username (non-secret, matches the Postgres source form)

port.description: Database port. sqlconnect-go unmarshals this into Port int, so a string here validates at create time and then fails the sync; the type is deliberately strict.

sslMode.description: SSL mode, passed through to lib/pq unchanged by sqlconnect-go. The set matches the modes rudder-lookout accepts for Postgres (POSTGRES_SSLMODES, src/lib/postgres-connection.ts); its own default is `require`.
